_comment: Seed deck for Up For It. Hostable units only: activity + rough when + place-type. Keep titles <=56, blurbs <=120, every named place real. months [] = year-round. exists = already a thing -> link, taught as a redirect. Edit here, then `node scripts/build-seed-sql.mjs` and re-paste the SQL.

ideas.title: Golden-hour hike up Mt. Philo, a September weeknight
ideas.blurb: Short climb to the lake-and-Adirondacks view; the park gate closes at dusk so we're down by then. Carpool, $5 day-use.

ideas.title: Foliage walk to the Ethan Allen Park tower
ideas.blurb: Easy forested loop in the New North End up to the 1905 stone tower and the city-and-lake view. Free, an hour, all paces.

ideas.title: Ride the Causeway to the cut before the ferry stops
ideas.blurb: Flat 3.5-mile ride out into the lake on the Island Line. Rent at Local Motion on the waterfront; $4 ferry hop optional.

ideas.title: Sunset paddle from North Beach, a calm weeknight
ideas.blurb: Kayaks and boards rent right on the sand at North Beach; hug the shore, watch the sun drop. Calm-water only.

ideas.title: Fog-morning walk at the Intervale, then coffee
ideas.blurb: Free trails through the farm fields while the autumn fog sits in the basin. Early alarm, easy pace, coffee after nearby.

ideas.title: Fall migration birding on the Delta Park boardwalk
ideas.blurb: Flat boardwalk to where the Winooski meets the lake — herons and waterfowl. Any binoculars work; free, an hour.

ideas.title: Sunset walk along the Lakeview Cemetery bluffs
ideas.blurb: Quiet Victorian garden paths on the bluffs above the lake — one of the best under-visited sunsets in town. Free, flat.

ideas.title: Apple picking at Shelburne Orchards, a Saturday morning
ideas.blurb: Pick-your-own with the Adirondacks behind the rows, fresh cider at the ciderhouse. Pay by the bag; carpool from town.

ideas.title: Cider donut run up Route 100, a foliage Sunday
ideas.blurb: Carpool to Cold Hollow for donuts warm from the fryer, Ben & Jerry's next door, leaves the whole way. Cheap, half a day.

ideas.title: Old North End cheap-eats crawl, a weeknight
ideas.blurb: Walk between Pho Hong, Taco Gordo and Ms. Weinerz, one small thing at each. Walkable, under $15 a stop, no reservations.

ideas.title: Golden-hour picnic at Oakledge, bring one thing
ideas.blurb: Blankets on the grass by the Earth Clock, everyone brings one dish or snack to share. Free, sunset included.

ideas.title: 40s and up: lakeside coffee walk from Perkins Pier
ideas.blurb: Coffee from Burlington Bay Café, then a stroll up the Greenway at talking pace. No agenda, for the 40-plus crowd.
ideas.origin: club:Burlington Social Activities Group (BTown Brief IRL)

ideas.title: 20s and 30s: after-work hang on a Pine Street patio
ideas.blurb: Meet at a Pine Street brewery or cidery patio after work, grab a table, meet people your age. Walkable, no cover.
ideas.origin: club:Burlington Social Activities Group (BTown Brief IRL)

ideas.title: New in town? Locals-led walk, waterfront to Church St
ideas.blurb: An hour on foot from Waterfront Park up to Church Street, locals pointing out the good stuff. Free; newcomers first.

ideas.title: Pinball night at the Pinball Co-op, a Wednesday
ideas.blurb: Forty machines on free play for one flat fee, alcohol-free, regulars explain the old games. Carpool to So. Burlington.

ideas.title: Double feature at the Sunset Drive-In, a Saturday
ideas.blurb: Carpool to Colchester, tune the radio, split the ~$12-a-car admission. Blankets and lawn chairs; one of Vermont's last.

ideas.title: Art Hop walk down Pine Street, opening night
ideas.blurb: Studios and galleries open along the South End during Art Hop weekend. Free, walkable, meet at the top of Pine.

ideas.title: Film photo walk through the Old North End
ideas.blurb: One roll each, any camera (LeZot has cheap ones and develops). Wander the ONE together, compare prints next week.

ideas.title: Silent book club: read an hour, then talk, a Sunday
ideas.blurb: Bring whatever you're reading to a downtown café, read quietly together, chat after. No assigned book, no prep.

ideas.title: Cheer squad at the Radio Bean open mic, a weeknight
ideas.blurb: Go as a table to the long-running open mic; sign up if you dare, applaud if you don't. Small cover at most.

ideas.title: Live music night at Maquam Winery, after work
ideas.blurb: The group has done this before and it worked: a live set, a glass or a soda, a table for ten. Carpool north.

ideas.title: After-work disc golf round at Schifilliti Park
ideas.blurb: Free course in the New North End; a starter set costs about what lunch does, or share discs. Beginners welcome.

ideas.title: Beginner pickleball on the Leddy Park courts
ideas.blurb: Four free lit courts, first come first served; rotate in, learn the rules in ten minutes. Bring or borrow a paddle.

ideas.title: Beginner yoga at Sangha Studio, then brunch
ideas.blurb: Drop into a donation-based beginner class on Pine Street or in the ONE, then walk to brunch. Pay what you can.

ideas.title: Sauna circuit at Savu, a chilly weeknight
ideas.blurb: Heat, plunge, Adirondack chair, repeat, on the waterfront. Everyone books their own slot; meet in the chairs.

ideas.title: Tour Generator makerspace on a Saturday
ideas.blurb: See the woodshop, laser cutters and 3D printers on Sears Lane at a Saturday enrollment session. Free to look.

ideas.title: Trail work morning with Fellowship of the Wheel
ideas.blurb: Join a volunteer trail day on local singletrack — tools provided, no bike required. Free, outdoors, you built that.

ideas.title: Thursday pickup ultimate with Vermont Ultimate
ideas.blurb: Free, all-levels summer pickup; the field is announced weekly. Cleats optional, running shoes fine.

exists.note: Already a thing: Vermont Ultimate pickup, Thursdays all summer

ideas.title: Try a contra dance at Shelburne Town Hall
ideas.blurb: Every dance is taught, no partner needed — come 15 minutes early for the beginner walkthrough. Live band, small fee.

exists.note: Already a thing: Queen City Contras, monthly Fridays 6:45pm

ideas.title: Learn-to-play board game night at The Boardroom
ideas.blurb: Burlington's big board game Meetup runs learn-to-play and open gaming several nights a week at the Main St game café.

exists.note: Already a thing: The Friendly Tabletop Gamers at The Boardroom
